sections.description: WENS Travel Studio Theme is a modern, full-site editing WordPress child theme of WENS Haelo, specifically designed for travel agencies, tour operators, and travel businesses. Its Itinerary page features curated travel packages displayed in a clean, grid-based layout. This layout highlights essential details, such as trip images, destinations, duration, pricing, and direct booking options. The theme incorporates advanced filtering features, allowing users to sort trips by price, type, location, date, and name, making it easy to find relevant trips quickly. Fully responsive and designed with a travel focus, this child theme is fully compatible with WP Travel and WP Travel Gutenberg Blocks, enabling complete management of trips, itineraries, pricing, and bookings. It also supports various travel-related Gutenberg blocks, including Trip Grid, Trip List, Trip Search, Featured Trips, Trip Calendar, Cart Button, and Trip Video. With a professional and lightweight interface that can be customized using the WordPress Site Editor, the theme includes call-to-action sections to engage users and encourage bookings. It is ideal for travel agencies, tour operators, adventure companies, and travel bloggers seeking a visually appealing, functional, and user-friendly travel booking website, all while leveraging the parent WENS Haelo theme for future updates.
